TEMPE, Ariz. - Amtech Systems, Inc. ( NASDAQ:ASYS ) announced that its Board of Directors has appointed Guy Shechter as President and Chief Executive Officer, effective August 13, 2026, according to a press release statement. Shechter has also been appointed to the company’s Board of Directors.

Bob Daigle, who has served as Chief Executive Officer since 2023 and Non-Executive Chairman since 2022, will transition to the newly created role of Executive Chairman of the Board. Daigle has been a board member since 2021.
Shechter joined Amtech in May 2026 as President and Chief Operating Officer. Prior to joining the company, he held leadership positions at Yield Engineering Systems from 2021 to 2026, most recently as Senior Vice President and General Manager. He previously held various leadership roles at Veeco Instruments from 2007 to 2020, including Vice President and General Manager, Global Services Solutions. Shechter holds an MBA and a Bachelor of Science degree in Mechanical Engineering from Technion - Israel Institute of Technology.

With the appointments, Amtech’s Board of Directors now consists of six members, four of whom are independent under Nasdaq listing standards.

As Executive Chairman, Daigle stated he will work with Shechter and the Board to support the company’s long-term growth and capital allocation strategy, which includes acquisitions and partnerships, and assist with shareholder communications.

## Recent Updates — ASYS

August 5, 2026 [View Source ↗](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/720500/000072050026000011/0000720500-26-000011-index.htm)

Amtech Systems announced that CEO Robert C. Daigle will retire as Chief Executive Officer on August 13, 2026, while remaining on the Board as Executive Chairman. The company appointed current President and COO Guy Shechter as the new CEO effective the same date. Daigle’s transition agreement includes a $300,000 annual base salary and a grant of 50,000 RSUs vesting over two years. Shechter received a grant of 25,000 RSUs vesting ratably over three years. The leadership change is not due to any disagreement regarding operations or policies. Amtech Systems operates in the semiconductor equipment industry, providing manufacturing solutions for advanced packaging and display technologies.
August 5, 2026 [View Source ↗](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/720500/000072050026000009/0000720500-26-000009-index.htm)

Amtech Systems reported fiscal third quarter results ending June 30, 2026, with net revenue of $22.4 million, a 14.5% increase year-over-year, driven by strong demand in its Thermal Processing Solutions segment. The company achieved GAAP net income of $1.7 million and non-GAAP net income of $2.4 million, while cash balances rose to $83.1 million following the receipt of $56.5 million in net proceeds from a public equity offering completed in June 2026. Customer orders increased to $28.8 million against a backlog of $28.7 million at quarter-end. The company provided fourth-quarter revenue guidance between $22.5 million and $24.0 million, anticipating continued strength in AI-related equipment demand. Amtech Systems manufactures equipment and consumables for AI semiconductor device packaging and advanced substrate fabrication.

**Amtech Systems Appoints Guy Shechter as Chief Executive Officer; Bob Daigle Transitions to Executive Chairman**

Amtech Systems, Inc.
("Amtech") (NASDAQ: ASYS), a manufacturer of equipment and consumables enabling AI semiconductor device packaging and advanced substrate fabrication, today announced that its Board of Directors has appointed Guy Shechter as President and Chief Executive Officer, effective August 13, 2026. Mr. Shechter also has been appointed to the Company’s Board of Directors. Concurrently, Bob Daigle, who has served on the Company’s board since 2021, as Non-Executive Chairman since 2022 and Chief Executive Officer since 2023, will transition to the newly created role of Executive Chairman of the Board.

With the appointments announced today, Amtech’s Board of Directors now consists of six members, four of whom are independent under Nasdaq listing standards, reinforcing the Company's commitment to best practices in corporate governance and independent oversight.

"I am pleased to announce Guy's appointment as Chief Executive Officer and this next phase of Amtech's leadership evolution," said Bob Daigle.
